instruction: Help me enable random/shuffle playback mode in VLC

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to enable VLC random/shuffle mode by setting 'random=1' in vlcrc. The evaluator reads the configuration file and verifies random mode is enabled (value 1). Default value is 0 (disabled). When enabled, playlist items play in random order.
